notes_for_editor: Very thin. The association's Virginia list is the only source found for this tower. Two web searches and a few page reads (Gathright Dam, Lake Moomaw, Gathright Wildlife Management Area on Wikipedia, and the FOREST LOOKOUTS Virginia index) found nothing about a tower called Skyline in Alleghany County. The Skyline match in the FOREST LOOKOUTS index is an Indiana place name, so it was not used. The story is about 47 words, far under the 120-word floor. Recommend holding it for a second pass, or publishing only if the editor accepts a short stub. Not in the FFLOS or NHLR registers, so no register event is recorded. No photo added.
